terbaru.judul: Fluid Notarization: Verifiable Evolution of Concurrently Edited Structured Documents
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper introduces Fluid Notarization, a notarization paradigm in which document evolution itself becomes the object of notarization.

terbaru.judul: Detecting Logic Vulnerabilities Across the Contract and Device Layers of Blockchain-Enabled IoT With Multi-Agent Heterogeneous Graph Attention
terbaru.pelajaran: Blockchain-enabled Internet of Things (IoT) systems integrate smart contracts with embedded devices to support decentralized device management and access control.

terbaru.judul: When AI Agents Meet MEV: Cross-Chain Arbitrage in the Agentic Economy
terbaru.pelajaran: We study cross-chain arbitrage when autonomous AI agents, rather than humans or bots, are the searchers.

terbaru.judul: Mitigating 51% Attacks in Blockchain Systems Through Early Detection and Checkpoint-Based Defense
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper proposes a two-layer defense that combines early hash-power monitoring with checkpoint-based mitigation.

terbaru.judul: Transparent Identity Verification Approach Using MPC and Efficient Credential Status Handling
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a transparent and cost-effective identity verification framework based on Multi-Party Computation (MPC).

terbaru.judul: The Deception Delta: Adversarial Evaluation of LLM-Based Smart Contract Bytecode Forensics
terbaru.pelajaran: Large language models are increasingly used in blockchain forensic investigations to interpret unverified smart contract bytecode.

terbaru.judul: PDoS: A Profitable Denial-of-Service Attack against Proof-of-Work Blockchain Liveness
terbaru.pelajaran: We present PDoS, a hybrid attack that combines block header signal deterrence with parasitic revenue extraction.

terbaru.judul: Heterogeneous Cross-Chain Transaction Tracing for Solana Bridges via Candidate-Set Selective Decision
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we formalize four types of Solana-bound cross-chain transaction modes and propose a candidate-set selective decision-based tracing method called SolTracer.
